## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e98faf9f68a02bf9095cdb2a17c39e4b3f27382a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectui/evals/page-builder.json, skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md + packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-page-action-block-variant-destructive-refused.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/expression-bindable-text-keys.zod.ts, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/runner-variant.ts, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-button.tsx, ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts, ui/packages/components/src/ui/button.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx, ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (the one moved CEILINGS row, read for ① and ③)

Inputs read:
- card #27243's body and all five comments (6496477382, 6497701693, 6498700895, 6498760578, 6499147451);
- PR #27588's body, its file list (4 files) and `git diff 72b08eec..e98faf9f`;
- the 57 check-runs on the head.

The rest of the diff (the changeset and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Skills-catalog grader accept set narrows (eval 4).** An answer to the new prompt now fails on the literal `"variant": "destructive"`. It must carry `action:button`, `"variant": "danger"` and `confirmText`.
  - This is the assertion card #27243 asks for.
  - The JSON key-value spelling follows the convention `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` records for objectui#7370. A bare word would fail an answer that names the rule while following it, since the prompt itself says "destructive".

  Right.
- **The ratchet accept set widens by exactly one row: `skills/objectui/evals/page-builder.json` 560 → 684.**
  - Audited with the header's hand-audit formula `ceil(wc -c / 4)`: base 2238 bytes → 560; head 2735 bytes → 684. Zero headroom, pinned AT the measurement.
  - The arithmetic holds: cases 1–3 prose 1206 → 914 bytes (−292), case 4 +789, net +497.
  - Paid down first, as claimed: the three existing `assertions` blocks are byte-identical to `main`, and every asserted fact survives. Only the unasserted "console-like" and "in the middle" are dropped from case 3.
  - It is justified under the 2026-10-27 ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」, and the comment block follows the file's pattern.
  - `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (ratchet + `--self-test`) is green.

  Right.
- **The published skill bundle (`@objectstack/skills`) changes.** `rules/protocol.md` gains one paragraph and loses two sentences: 17428 → 17464 bytes, 4357 → 4366 of 4368 tokens, no ceiling moved. Prose only. Right.
- **No spec, runtime or public API surface changes.** No `packages/*` or `ui/packages/*` source is touched. Right.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the PR body. Patch is right. `Check Changeset` and `check-changeset-no-major` are green.

Should-fix (non-blocking, prose outside `hits`): the changeset body describes only the teaching line and its two deletions, not eval 4 or the ceiling move.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` (6498700895, how the eval gets paid): answered by claim amendment 6498760578 (option A) and executed in `e98faf9f`. Closed.
- The PR body keeps `Part of #27243`, and the seat closes the card by hand after the merge. `PR-body guards` is green. A post-merge to-do, not a defect.
- The first commit's author is `marchtian`: cosmetic. The trailer pair is present.
- Should-fix (non-blocking): the PR body is stale after the patch round.
  - Its Tests table says `page-builder.json` is "untouched" and that "no ceiling moves".
  - Its 维护者速读 says 「上限不动」 and asks the maintainer to decide the raise.
  - Its Acceptance notes call the eval "held".

  All three are false on this head. The tree, not the body, was judged.
- Check-runs on `e98faf9f`: complete. 49 `success`, 8 `skipped`, none failed; `check-expected-skips` OK. No gate family is pending.
- The dev's out-of-scope finding (the 18.x migration entry says `element:button` keeps `destructive`) is filed as #27589. It is not this PR's text.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`**: the paragraph at L275–L278 and the two deletions.

- "`"variant": "danger"` draws the button red": `component.zod.ts` L3451 `ACTION_BLOCK_VARIANTS` carries `danger`; `runner-variant.ts` maps `toButtonVariant('danger')` to `'destructive'`; `action-button.tsx` L209 draws it; `button.tsx` L21 styles `destructive`. Holds.
- "asks its `confirmText` question through the destructive confirm button": `action-button.tsx` L329 and L333 forward `confirmText` and `toRunnerVariant(schema.variant)`. `ActionRunner.ts` L1973–L1979 sets `destructive: action.variant === 'danger'`, consumed at L1616–L1618. `confirmText` is on the `action:button` row (`component.zod.ts` L3965). Holds.
- "`destructive` is the Button primitive's word": `button.tsx` L21, and the spec itself says so (L2230, L2342). Holds.
  - The line does NOT say `element:button` keeps it, so it does not repeat the #27589 inaccuracy: `ElementButtonPropsSchema.variant` L2968 has `danger`, and `elements.tsx` L311 maps it.
- "refused at save, naming the rename": `component.zod.ts` L3460–L3463 and L3472–L3477, plus the protocol-18 entry. Holds.
  - Observation only: `action:bar` has no props row and nothing refuses `destructive` on it. The paragraph sits under the `action:button` example, so its reach is clear.
- Deletion 1 (retired `dataSource` provenance): the retirement is taught at L221–L229, and the live route is still stated at L138–L140. No teaching lost.
- Deletion 2 ("a `${...}` on the node is never evaluated …"): the `props` half is at L22, L105–L111 and table row 2; the `${...}` half is at table row 4 and L97–L98. No teaching lost.
  - The sentence was overbroad: `EXPRESSION_BINDABLE_TEXT_KEYS_BY_COMPONENT` (L140–L143) declares `card.title` bindable, which L84 teaches. Removing it is an improvement.
  - Pre-existing on `main` and out of scope: table row 4 (`card` `title` read raw) sits in tension with L84. Noted for the seat. Dedupe words: `protocol.md row 4 card title bindable`.

**`skills/objectui/evals/page-builder.json`**: eval 4 and the tightened cases 1–3.

- Every `must_contain` token is taught whole in the bundle: `action:button` at L255/L266, `"variant": "danger"` at L275, `confirmText` at L276. `check:skill-eval-tokens` is green. It is the bundle's first case on an action block's `variant`.
- Does `must_not_contain` wrongly fail a correct answer? Only an answer that quotes the refused JSON literal verbatim as a counter-example would fail. An answer naming the primitive's word, or showing the React `Button variant="destructive"`, passes. This is the same accepted boundary as case 2's `"props": {`, and it is the objectui#7370 convention. Accepted limit.
- Can a wrong answer pass? `"variant":"destructive"` (no space) evades the literal, but the answer must still spell all three `must_contain` tokens. Substring grading is by design (`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md` L25). No fix.
- Self-agreement: no case's `must_not_contain` string appears in its own `expected_output` or prompt.
- The tightened cases keep every assertion byte-for-byte.

No must-fix. Should-fixes: the stale PR body (③) and the stale changeset body (②), both prose outside `hits`.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-27243-objectui-action-variant-eval`
Reviewed-by: `session_017ihL2dPRZXfgE1A2Vct3FU`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `193f4bb93875ac8a725830a81b56e51b0d49d4a8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectui/evals/page-builder.json, skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md + .changeset/27243-objectui-action-variant-eval.md (the only path the delta touches; read against the two `hits` files and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` on this head)

Delta review of `git diff e98faf9f 193f4bb9`, read with `git fetch` / `git show` only. The full record on `e98faf9f` (comment 6499375522) carries ①–④ for the `hits` files.

### ① Derived judgments

- The delta is one commit (parent `e98faf9f`), one file, one insertion: a third bullet in the changeset. No accept set and no public surface moves; nothing in `skills/**`, `scripts/**`, `packages/**` or `ui/**` changed. ① of the `e98faf9f` record stands.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Right.
- The new bullet is accurate against this head:
  - Eval 4's `must_contain` is exactly `action:button`, `"variant": "danger"` and `confirmText`; its `must_not_contain` is exactly `"variant": "destructive"`.
  - Cases 1–3 are tightened, and their `assertions` blocks are byte-identical to `main`.
  - The CEILINGS row reads `684` (ratchet L1193), equal to `ceil(2735 / 4)`.
  - The ruling is quoted verbatim.

  The previous record's ② should-fix is closed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Nothing else moved. The head's parent is `e98faf9f`, the diff is the one bullet, and the commit author is the configured `Claude` with the trailer pair.
- The PR-body should-fix stays unapplied: the relay refuses an `issue_patch` whose first line is the attribution marker. The seat's ACCEPT carries the corrected reading. Non-blocking.
- Check-runs at the reviewer's read: none failed. `Check Changeset` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, the two the delta can move, were still pending. The verdict is conditional on them finishing green. The seat reads them before ACCEPT.

### ④ Design judgment

- The delta touches neither `hits` file. ④ of the `e98faf9f` record stands: the teaching paragraph and eval 4 are byte-identical to the reviewed head. No must-fix and no should-fix inside the diff.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-27243-objectui-action-variant-eval`
Reviewed-by: `session_017ihL2dPRZXfgE1A2Vct3FU`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · #27243 · head `193f4bb93875ac8a725830a81b56e51b0d49d4a8` · 2026-10-29T14:46Z

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：
  - 给 `objectui` skill 加一句教学：action 按钮（`action:button` 等）要画成红色并弹出危险确认，写 `"variant": "danger"`；`destructive` 是 React Button 原件的词，写在 action 块上，保存时会被拒。
  - 在 `evals/page-builder.json` 加一道评测题：要求做一个「删除产品」按钮，答案必须写出 `"variant": "danger"` 和 `confirmText`，写 `"variant": "destructive"` 判错。
  - 原有三道题的措辞压短了，断言一条没删。
- 为什么改：#26966 把 action 块的 `destructive` 改名为 `danger`，但 skill 里没有任何地方教这个写法。照着 React 示例写 `destructive` 的 AI 作者会在保存时被拒。
- **与 PR 描述不一致的地方（以本条为准）：** PR 描述写于补丁轮之前，里面的「评测题暂缓」「上限不动」、请你裁决是否提高上限，这几句都已过时。
  - 本 PR 已经包含这道评测题。
  - `page-builder.json` 的 token 上限从 560 提到 684，按的是 2026-10-27 你已裁决的选项 A「先削重复,余额按实测提高」：先把原有三道题压短，省下 292 字节，余额按实测值 684 提高，只动这一行。

  中继不允许改写 PR 描述，所以更正写在这里。
- 风险与回滚：只改了 skill 正文一段、评测文件、token 棘轮里的一行上限，外加一个 patch changeset。spec、运行时、渲染器都没动。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` L275–L278（新教学句）、`skills/objectui/evals/page-builder.json` 的 eval 4。
- 两分钟验证：跑 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 和 `node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`，两条都应 exit 0。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR（Tier H，`skills/**`）。契约复核 PASS 在案：完整复核 6499375522（`e98faf9f`），增量复核 6499430569（`Head-sha: 193f4bb93875ac8a725830a81b56e51b0d49d4a8`）。批准后由本席落地，并手动关闭 #27243（PR 描述写的是 `Part of`）。

席位意见：独立 Fable 完整复核没有 must-fix。它提了两条 should-fix：changeset 说明已补上；PR 描述过时，由本条更正。

### 席位核对

1. **Shape**: 4 files, +58/−11. Every file is inside the claimed surface, as amended by 6498760578: one fixture, one rules file, one CEILINGS row, one changeset. Tier H (`skills/**`).
2. **Premise check**:
   - The claim's measurement still holds: no objectui eval named `variant` on `main` `72b08eec`.
   - The reviewer re-read every taught fact against the spec and renderer on the head: `ACTION_BLOCK_VARIANTS`, the `destructive` refusal, `toButtonVariant`, the `ActionRunner` confirm path.
   - The new line does not repeat the inaccuracy filed as #27589.
3. **Gate check-runs** on `193f4bb9`: 49 success, 8 skipped, none failed, including `Check Changeset` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates`. `check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 27588`: OK. Mergeable `clean`. `check-governed-merges`: Tier H, 69 lines.
4. **Accepted deviations**:
   - The PR body is stale after the patch round; this comment carries the correct reading. The relay refuses a body `issue_patch` whose first line is the attribution marker.
   - The PR body says `Part of #27243`, so the seat closes the card by hand.
   - The first commit's author field reads `marchtian` (cosmetic; the trailers are model-free). The amend was not taken.
   - The seat wrote the changeset bullet itself (commit `193f4bb9`, one line) and had it reviewed as a delta.
   - Five gates were NOT MEASURED locally (unbuilt tree, exit 3). CI carries them green.
5. **Out-of-scope dispositions**:
   - (a) The 18.x migration entry says `element:button` keeps `destructive`: filed as #27589 (`domain:spec`, `finding`).
   - (b) `protocol.md` table row 4 (`card` `title` read raw) is in tension with L84 and `EXPRESSION_BINDABLE_TEXT_KEYS_BY_COMPONENT`. This is pre-existing on `main`. Dropped from this PR — not this card's ask, and the seat checks it before any filing.
   - `Skills-docs:` n/a (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
6. **Serial constraints**: none. No open PR touches `skills/objectui/**`. The ratchet script's one row is disjoint from other open PRs.
7. **Landing clause**: Tier H. This hands off to `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (`os-zhuang`, `hotlong`) via `pr_request_reviewers`, with `needs-user-decision` on the PR while it waits. After an APPROVED review with every check green, the seat will:
   - strip the label;
   - run `pr_ready` and `automerge_enable`;
   - confirm MERGED;
   - close #27243 by hand.
